name: Triple confluence with TP-then-trail runner: fear + VIX + funding flush, asymmetric exit
rationale: Thesis: the entry edge (cross-market stress triple: fear_greed extreme-low + vix_level elevated + funding_rate flushed) is real, but capping it at one flat take-profit leaves the post-capitulation trend leg on the table. An asymmetric exit — take a partial at the first TP leg, move the stop to break-even, then trail the runner — should let winners ride the recovery while capping risk after the bounce is banked. All three entry axes bounded levels; all exit distances are fitted ParamRefs (no magic numbers). Long-only spot. Disconfirmer: run the SAME entry triple with a SINGLE flat take-profit (no plan); the runner version must beat the flat one on deflated Sharpe net of fees. If the flat TP matches, the multi-leg break-even+trail adds only complexity, not edge. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: cross-market stress triple, then ride the recovery with a trailing runner
